law_record.title: When pedestrian must yield right-of-way to vehicle (1)(c)
law_record.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: Between adjacent intersections at which official traffic-control devices are in operation pedestrians shall not cross at any place except in a marked crosswalk.

activation_conditions: the subject is a pedestrian crossing between two adjacent intersections at which traffic-control devices are in operation
exceptions: the white-cane rule governs instead where it applies
residue: 'adjacent intersections' is a concept over the lane graph (st.lane_enters with st.lane_connectivity): two intersections are adjacent when the lanes between them enter one and lead from the other with no intersection between
summary.subject: pedestrian

timing_requirements.requirement: the violation is the crossing itself, judged where the footprint enters the roadway
the device at both intersections must be in operation at that time, not merely installed
